steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why didn't you tell me earlier?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you still walk? Do you feel discomfort in your body, your head, or your legs?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Oh, chill out! I'm the most wicked villain DisCity has ever seen, nothing bad can happen to me! I just... can't help bleating occasionally.
She acts all excited and wags her sheep tail, but her body still makes a wooden creak. This is not a good sign...

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Hey, hey, it's all good! It's not every day I get to see you with such cute, beady eyes. Don't you make that face, Chief! Anyway, you came inside the factory to find me, I swear I won't let anything happen to you!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: If entering this place turns you into a toy, perhaps all we need to do is just get out? I'm sure you'll figure something out once we escape from here!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you say you can't push this door open?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Yeah! So I've been looking for another exit!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's another exit? Where?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Hehe... haven't found it yet! But I believe in you, Chief!
Pepper twists her head somewhat proudly, again making that noise of a worn-out toy.
Seeing her struggle to move, you can't bring yourself to tell her off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be more than one way out of here. If that old scavenger wasn't lying, then this place used to be just an ordinary toy factory. There must be other exits.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Manufacturing, production, sales...
Trying your best to calm down, you set your eyes on the most conspicuous conveyor belt in the middle of the workshop.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: What is it? Do you want to help these plastic dolls out with their work?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Well, guess I have no other choice! Pepper will join you too!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The products made by the factory definitely wouldn't stay in the factory forever.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: They'd go to shops! The big malls in Eastside!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, the main entrance might be used only by humans, but there must be a passage used only by toys. So, how do they get out of this factory...?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Transported out with a large truck!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And how do the toys in the factory get to the truck?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Well... by manual handling!
Looking at Pepper in front of you, self-satisfied with her own "smartness", you suddenly miss Hella and Hecate.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Oh, oh, I know! The conveyor belt! You're too smart, Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You finally caught on... Keep your voice down, don't disturb those working plastic dolls.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Though we're not sure if they can hear with those plastic ears, startling them is definitely not a good idea.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Follow me, go around them, and climb onto the conveyor belt. How's your body feeling?
The little wooden tries to stand at attention, making little clicks and clacks.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: As good as new!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go.
You take the lead and move. The cotton soles of your feet step on the concrete floor almost soundlessly.
You advance, sticking to the shadows of the machines while carefully observing the toys on the assembly line.
Fortunately, they don't notice anything unusual.
The little wooden sheep nods, carefully lifting her wooden feet to move closer to you with wobbly steps.
Pepper's body is obviously not as easy to operate as yours. She tries her best to hide behind the piles of toy blocks around her, moving inch by inch unsteadily.
Clack! The wood hits the cement floor, inevitably making a slight knocking sound. Startled, Pepper gasps.

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: We are workers of the factory!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier B
steps.content: We belong here!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier C
steps.content: Be diligent and serious. No slacking off!
The chant doesn't stop, and they haven't noticed you yet. If Pepper just hangs in there for a bit more, you can both slip into their blind spot.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=30>It's okay, Pepper, keep going.</size>
Clack, clack, clack. The wooden sheep speeds up on her tiptoes. Just one more step, one more step...

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: Oi!
The worst-case scenario ends up coming true. The plastic dolls stopped their work, and their three pairs of hollow blue eyes without whites or pupils...
...Turn to look at you!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier A
steps.content: You are different!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier B
steps.content: You are not workers yet!

steps.speaker: Blue Soldier C
steps.content: No slacking off! Punish them! Punish them!
